title: Detailed sun
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g stroke='none'>
    <!-- rays -->
    <g fill='#FFC94A'>
      <polygon points='50,4 54,22 50,26 46,22'/>
      <polygon points='50,96 54,78 50,74 46,78'/>
      <polygon points='4,50 22,46 26,50 22,54'/>
      <polygon points='96,50 78,46 74,50 78,54'/>
      <polygon points='17,17 30,29 29,34 24,33'/>
      <polygon points='83,17 70,29 71,34 76,33'/>
      <polygon points='17,83 30,71 29,66 24,67'/>
      <polygon points='83,83 70,71 71,66 76,67'/>
    </g>
    <!-- short thin rays between -->
    <g fill='#FFE27A'>
      <polygon points='36,6 39,15 36,17 33,15'/>
      <polygon points='64,6 61,15 64,17 67,15'/>
      <polygon points='36,94 39,85 36,83 33,85'/>
      <polygon points='64,94 61,85 64,83 67,85'/>
      <polygon points='6,36 15,39 17,36 15,33'/>
      <polygon points='94,36 85,39 83,36 85,33'/>
      <polygon points='6,64 15,61 17,64 15,67'/>
      <polygon points='94,64 85,61 83,64 85,67'/>
    </g>
    <!-- outer disc -->
    <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='30' fill='#FF9E1B'/>
    <!-- inner disc -->
    <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='24' fill='#FFC93C'/>
    <!-- glow highlight -->
    <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='17' fill='#FFE98A'/>
    <!-- face -->
    <g fill='#B85C00'>
      <ellipse cx='42' cy='45' rx='3' ry='4'/>
      <ellipse cx='58' cy='45' rx='3' ry='4'/>
    </g>
    <!-- cheeks -->
    <g fill='#FF7B54'>
      <circle cx='37' cy='54' r='3.5'/>
      <circle cx='63' cy='54' r='3.5'/>
    </g>
    <!-- smile -->
    <path d='M41 56 Q50 65 59 56' stroke='#B85C00' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>
</svg>
